title: Interpreting Object-Dependent Concept Brittleness in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
authors: Yifan Yuan*, Xiangyu Liu*, Hongming Shan, Yu Han, Yu Jiang, Hao Tan, Junping Zhang, Linlin Shen†
imageAlt: Two-stage framework: sparse prior construction in SAE space and prior-guided denoising intervention
summaryEn: Text-to-image models apply a concept (e.g., “ink sketch”) correctly to most objects yet repeatedly fail on a few. We diagnose this brittleness with step-wise sparse autoencoders on denoising features and repair it at inference time without retraining, across five diffusion backbones.
summaryZh: 文生图模型能把某一概念（如“水墨素描”）正确施加到大多数物体上，却在少数物体上反复失败。我们用逐时间步的稀疏自编码器诊断这种“物体依赖的概念脆弱性”，并在推理阶段免训练修复，在五种扩散模型上验证有效。

title: When LLMs Forget What They Believe: Characterizing State Integrity Collapse in Long-Horizon Dialogues
summaryEn: LLMs can repeat an instruction yet stop obeying it. We define State Integrity Collapse and build StateTrack-Bench: across seven models, 88.6% of failures are behavioral drift rather than forgetting, and Structured State Anchoring recovers up to 24.4 points.
summaryZh: 大模型能复述指令，却不再遵守它。我们定义了“状态完整性崩塌”并构建 StateTrack-Bench：在七个模型上，88.6% 的失败源于行为漂移而非遗忘；结构化状态锚定最多可挽回 24.4 个百分点。

title: ReMCTS: Reflection-Enhanced Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation
authors: Wang Huifei, Huang Xinying, Sun Yiheng, Yifan Yuan†
summaryEn: An execution-grounded, memory-augmented tree search for code generation that keeps branch-local debugging context and reuses failure experience across branches; it beats direct generation in 8 of 10 model–dataset pairs on HumanEval and MBPP.
summaryZh: 面向代码生成的执行驱动、记忆增强的树搜索框架：保留分支内的调试上下文，并跨分支复用失败经验；在 HumanEval 与 MBPP 的 10 组模型—数据集组合中有 8 组优于直接生成。

title: SurveyGraph: Generating Academic Surveys via Methods-Entity Knowledge Graphs
authors: Yifan Yuan, Yancheng Zhu, Zuoyu Zhang, Xiaogang Peng†
summaryEn: SurveyGraph builds a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph that records how methods extend, compete with, and share resources with one another, and uses it for core-paper discovery, graph-aware retrieval, outline generation, and evolution-aware survey writing.
summaryZh: SurveyGraph 构建方法—实体知识图谱（MEKG），刻画方法之间的继承、竞争与资源共享关系，并据此完成核心论文发现、图感知检索、大纲生成与演化式综述写作。

title: Dissecting and Mitigating Semantic Discrepancy in Stable Diffusion for Image-to-Image Translation
authors: Yifan Yuan, Guanqun Yang, James Z. Wang, Hui Zhang, Hongming Shan, Feiyue Wang†, Junping Zhang
imageAlt: Overview of the training-free semantic discrepancy correction with single-step DDIM inversion
summaryEn: Adding noise to the reference image, as SDEdit does, makes text-to-image models invent content and relations that are not in the original. We trace this “semantic discrepancy” to correlations disrupted during U-Net upsampling and fix it training-free with features from a single DDIM-inversion step, 11.2× faster than PnP.
summaryZh: 像 SDEdit 那样直接给参考图加噪，会让文生图模型凭空生成原图中没有的内容与关系。我们发现这种“语义偏差”源于 U-Net 上采样时被破坏的特征相关性，并用单步 DDIM 反演的特征进行免训练修正，速度比 PnP 快 11.2 倍。
